title: Special Provisions in Waterfront Access Plan BK-1
previewText: Docks for water taxis and docks or mooring facilities for non-commercial pleasure boats, listed under Use Group IV(B) in Section 32-14 or 42-14, shall be permitted uses on any parcel identified in Waterfront Access Plan BK-1.
